nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for the @waggle/hive-mind-hooks-codex-desktop package, explaining that it is a thin re-export shim of @waggle/hive-mind-hooks-codex that wires OpenAI Codex Desktop lifecycle hooks (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, PreCompact) into hive-mind frames via the shared ~/.codex/hooks.json config root.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @waggle/hive-mind-hooks-codex-desktop v0.1.0, a thin re-export shim package with a CLI binary (codex-desktop-hooks) that delegates entirely to @waggle/hive-mind-hooks-codex, existing solely to provide a distinct package boundary for the dependency graph and launcher hook resolution.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ESM module type with tsc composite build; declares @waggle/hive-mind-hooks-codex as a direct dependency (the entire implementation) and @waggle/hive-mind-cli as an optional peer.
